info.title: Network Inspector CLI
info.description: Command-line interface for the Network Inspector stack. Provides ni convert and ni export for network and automotive captures, ni plugins to load extensions, and ni settings and ni profile for settings profiles.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (required)

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output format spec (see below; overrides extension)

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace an existing output (otherwise an existing output is an error)

options.name: --max-frames
options.description: Maximum number of frames to convert

options.name: --split-size
options.description: Split when exporter EstimatedOutputBytes reaches this size (MiB; live, no FS probe)

options.name: --split-count
options.description: Split output every N frames

options.name: --filter
options.description:
Only keep packets matching this filter expression
(frames are parsed only when a filter is set)

options.name: --profile
options.description: Settings profile (must exist; 'default' is created on first use)

options.name: --set
options.description:
Override one setting for this run only, e.g. --set settings.maxFileSize=1GiB (repeatable;
a limit takes a number with a unit, or off; see ni settings describe --limits)

options.name: --progress
options.description: Report progress every N frames

options.name: --tolerant
options.description: Skip malformed frames instead of aborting

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the parse work chosen for the run (parse: none | fields only, no tree (…) | field tree (…))

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
Output format is auto-detected from the output extension (plugins add more; see 'ni plugins list'):
.pcapng / other       PCAPNG (default)
.blf                  BLF with default compression
.asc                  CANalyzer ASCII log (CAN, CAN FD, CAN XL, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet)
AFDX data frames are read. AFDX status, AFDX bus statistics, ETH STAT, and ETH RxEr are not read.
Output format specifications (--output-format):
pcapng                PCAPNG format
blf                   BLF, default compression
blf:compression=off   BLF, no compression
blf:compression=fast  BLF, fast compression
blf:compression=best  BLF, best compression ratio
asc                   CANalyzer ASCII log (CAN, CAN FD, CAN XL, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet)
Source specifications (plugins add more kinds; see 'ni plugins list'):
capture.pcap[ng]      Auto-detected PCAP/PCAPNG
data.blf              Auto-detected BLF
log.asc               Auto-detected CANalyzer ASC
pcap:path=<file>      Explicit PCAP spec; pcapng:path=<file>, blf:path=<file>, asc:path=<file>
random:count=N,seed=S,mode=udp4|udp6|random  Synthetic frames

options.name: --split-size

options.name: --split-count

options.name: --filter
options.description: Only keep packets matching this filter expression

options.name: --profile
options.description: Settings profile (must exist; 'default' is created on first use)

options.name: --set
options.description:
Override one setting for this run only, e.g. --set settings.maxFileSize=1GiB (repeatable;
a limit takes a number with a unit, or off; see ni settings describe --limits)

options.name: --progress
options.description: Report progress every N packets

options.name: --tolerant
options.description: Skip malformed frames instead of aborting

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the parse work chosen for the run (parse: none | fields only, no tree (…) | field tree (…))

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
Source specifications (plugins add more kinds; see 'ni plugins list'):
capture.pcap[ng]      Auto-detected PCAP/PCAPNG file
data.blf              Auto-detected BLF file
log.asc               Auto-detected CANalyzer ASC file
pcap:path=<file>      Explicit PCAP spec; pcapng:path=<file>, blf:path=<file>, asc:path=<file>
random:count=N,seed=S,mode=udp4|udp6|tcp4|tcp6|tcpstream4|tcpstream6|ethernet|ipv4|ipv6|can|canfd|fullrandom
Synthetic frames
<kind>:key=value,...  Any source kind; options are Core settings (see the documentation of the kind)
Format specifications (plugins add more formats; see 'ni plugins list'):
csv                   Comma-separated values (default for .csv); No., Time, Info, Length
csv:fields=ip.src;udp.dstport,delimiter=;,header=false,bom=false
One column per field (ip.src:last picks an occurrence), delimiter, header row, byte order mark
csv:neutralizeFormulas=false
Write text cells unchanged (default: a text cell that starts with = + - @ tab or CR gets a
leading ' so that a spreadsheet does not run it as a formula)
json                  Compact JSON (default for .json)
json:style=compact    Compact JSON
json:style=pretty     Pretty-printed JSON
json:style=array      JSON array format
pbf                   Standard PBF
pbf:format=standard   Standard (row-oriented) PBF
pbf:format=columnar   Columnar PBF
pbf:format=columnar,compressed  Columnar PBF with LZ4
text                  Human-readable protocol tree (default for .txt)
text:level=summary    Protocol containers only (no field values)
text:level=standard   All fields except raw bytes (default)
text:level=full       All fields including raw bytes
text:truncate=N       Truncate values at N characters (0 = unlimited, default: 256)
text:level=full,truncate=0  Full detail without any truncation
parquet               Columnar Parquet directory (requires -o <dir>)
duckdb                DuckDB database file (requires -o <file>.duckdb)

commands.name: profile
commands.description: List, create, rename, and delete settings profiles

options.name: --settings-path
options.description: Base directory for settings storage

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
Names: 1 to 256 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes, and underscores; not application, logs, plugins,
plugins-data, plugin-scan-cache, host, app, or presets.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create an empty profile or a copy of another one

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a profile (the last profile cannot be deleted)

commands.name: list
commands.description: Print the profile names, one per line

commands.name: settings
commands.description: List, read, change, and reset application and profile settings

options.name: --profile
options.description: Settings profile (must exist; 'default' is created on first use)

options.name: --set
options.description:
Override one setting for this run only, e.g. --set settings.maxFileSize=1GiB (repeatable;
not allowed with set and reset; a limit takes a number with a unit, or off)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
Values: true/false, numbers, hex bytes (0A1B), enumeration names, text, and arrays as JSON ([1,2]) or comma lists.
Relative paths in plugins.paths are stored as full paths. A stored value of a plugin that is not loaded is JSON.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: What a setting is; for a limit what it bounds and why

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Remove the stored value; the default applies
